item.title: It's going to hurt, like it should
item.description:
Even if it will soon be over like the platitude states, it is going to hurt. Yes it will. You can optimize and hack around all you want to, but for some of what you want to achieve, there's no way to the goal but through the fire.

And don't complain about it like it's a bad thing. It's by design.

The reward would not be anywhere close to as valuable as it is, if getting it did not involve some hurdles.

item.title: Life's events, like life, are nothing but a vapor.
item.description:
It appears and its sooner than later, nothing. Gone. A memory. A forgotten memory.

Many ways in which your time could be sub divided. Divisions over events that are soon over after they start.

A holiday, a school session,a workout session,a morning shower, a job search work ,an X day work out challenge, a meeting with someone, a hard conversation,a meal ,a walk.

What to do about this finite nature:

Put in your all. Be present in every moment however mundane. Because soon, it will be over. And all that'll be left will be memories for what you did. Or regrets about what you chose not to.
